verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HMRC runs a live, versioned production REST API platform with a structured error contract (hmrc-probe-1) and a sanctioned Making Tax Digital software channel (hmrc-supp-3). However, nothing in the pack shows a published machine-readable specification such as an OpenAPI document, XML schemas or a data dictionary. The developer hub that would host such documentation was not fetched because its robots.txt disallows crawlers (hmrc-probe-2), so a spec may exist but is unevidenced here.
